announcement.title_cn: 关于深铁集团向公司提供不超过16.66亿元借款暨关联交易的公告

extraction.title_en: Announcement on Shenzhen Metro Group Providing Up to CNY 1.666 Billion in Loans to the Company, Constituting a Related-Party Transaction
extraction.summary_en: Shenzhen Metro Group, the company's largest shareholder holding 27.18%, will provide a loan of up to CNY 1.666 billion to China Vanke, to be used to repay principal and interest on the company's public-market bonds. The loan carries a term of up to 3 years, priced at 1-year LPR minus 66 basis points (currently 2.34%), with interest settled quarterly. Shenzhen Metro Group may require the company to provide guarantees, including asset pledges, subject to shareholder approval at an extraordinary general meeting scheduled for 20 November 2025. The board approved the transaction on 10 November 2025 with related directors abstaining, and independent directors endorsed it.
